notes: The *hath* of the first line is placed on אִישׁ under rule 43's nominal-recasting paragraph, since the ASV recasts the whole nominal as a head noun plus a relative clause of having; the competing reading would mark it `added`.
The assimilated article of לַהוֹן is a real token (rule 12) and is `unrepresented`, the ASV writing *after riches* anarthrously.
